+from fastapi import FastAPI
+import pytest

+def test_external_docs():
+    external_docs = {"description": "External Docs", "url": "https://example.com/docs"}
+    try:
+        app = FastAPI(external_docs=external_docs)
+    except TypeError as e:
+        print(f"Caught expected TypeError: {e}")
+        raise e
+    
+    openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+    assert "info" in openapi_schema
+    assert "externalDocs" in openapi_schema["info"]
+    assert openapi_schema["info"]["externalDocs"] == external_docs
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_external_docs()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
